# IoT Network Intrusion Detection

Machine learning project for detecting network attacks targeting IoT devices, based on the IoTID20 dataset.

## Overview

IoT devices are resource-constrained and often poorly secured, making them frequent targets for network attacks. This project builds a classification model that distinguishes normal traffic from malicious traffic (anomalies) using network flow features.

Traffic classes:
- Normal
- Malicious (DDoS, botnet, port scan, and others)

## Dataset

**IoTID20** — real and simulated network traffic generated by IoT devices.

- Source: [Kaggle — IoTID20 Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/rohulaminlabid/iotid20-dataset)
- Saved model and project files: [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xqMZk431MlVFa-ExxrGJd7S3Y5vrohdP?usp=drive_link)

## Setup

```bash
conda env create -f environment.yml
conda activate <env_name>
jupyter notebook project.ipynb
```

## Feature Engineering

Key features selected for the model, grouped by attack-detection relevance:

### Time statistics
*DDoS attacks have short duration but high packet rate.*

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Timestamp | Flow start time |
| Flow_Duration | Total flow duration |

### Packet statistics
*Many packets with little data — characteristic of flooding attacks.*

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Tot_Fwd_Pkts | Packet count: source → destination |
| Tot_Bwd_Pkts | Packet count: destination → source |
| TotLen_Fwd_Pkts | Total bytes forwarded |
| TotLen_Bwd_Pkts | Total bytes backward |

### Packet sizes
*Low variance in packet size is characteristic of botnets — automated traffic is uniform.*

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Fwd_Pkt_Len_Max | Max forward packet length |
| Fwd_Pkt_Len_Min | Min forward packet length |
| Fwd_Pkt_Len_Mean | Mean forward packet length |
| Fwd_Pkt_Len_Std | Std deviation of forward packet length |
| Bwd_Pkt_Len_Max | Max backward packet length |
| Bwd_Pkt_Len_Min | Min backward packet length |
| Bwd_Pkt_Len_Mean | Mean backward packet length |
| Bwd_Pkt_Len_Std | Std deviation of backward packet length |

### Flow statistics
*Extremely high bytes/s or packets/s indicate DDoS.*

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Flow_Byts/s | Bytes per second |
| Flow_Pkts/s | Packets per second |

### Inter-arrival times
*Constant inter-arrival time suggests automated (bot) traffic.*

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Flow_IAT_Mean | Mean time between packets |
| Flow_IAT_Std | Std deviation of inter-arrival time |
| Flow_IAT_Max | Max inter-arrival time |
| Flow_IAT_Min | Min inter-arrival time |

### TCP flags
*SYN flood: only SYN flags, no ACK. In normal TCP traffic, flags are balanced.*

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| FIN_Flag_Cnt | FIN flag count |
| SYN_Flag_Cnt | SYN flag count |
| RST_Flag_Cnt | RST flag count |
| PSH_Flag_Cnt | PSH flag count |
| ACK_Flag_Cnt | ACK flag count |
| URG_Flag_Cnt | URG flag count |
| CWE_Flag_Count | CWE flag count |
| ECE_Flag_Cnt | ECE flag count |

### TCP session info
*Short session with no idle time is a possible attack indicator.*

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Init_Fwd_Win_Byts | Initial forward window size |
| Init_Bwd_Win_Byts | Initial backward window size |
| Fwd_Act_Data_Pkts | Forward packets carrying actual data |
| Fwd_Seg_Size_Min | Minimum forward segment size |
| Active_Mean | Mean active time |
| Active_Std | Std deviation of active time |
